impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn match_receiver_header(&mut self) {
        while let Ok(record) = match self.lane_selector_for_this_block {
            Lane::Left => &mut self.left_consumer,
            Lane::Right => &mut self.right_consumer,
        }
        .try_pop()
        {
            let _ = record;
        }
    }
}
